image.name: piwigo
image.description: [Piwigo](http://piwigo.org/) is a photo gallery software for the web that comes with powerful features to publish and manage your collection of pictures.

changelog.desc: Rebase to Alpine 3.22, always update default theme on startup.
Revert to Alpine 3.21 due to incorrectly stated upstream support for PHP 8.4.
Rebase to Alpine 3.20. Existing users should update their nginx confs to avoid http2 deprecation warnings.
Increase php workers to fix Android uploading in bulk
Revert to Alpine 3.17 due to compatibility issues with php 8.2.
Rebase to Alpine 3.16, migrate to s6v3. Move application install to /app/www/public, add migration for existing users. Container updates should now update the application correctly.
Rebasing to alpine 3.15 with php8. Restructure nginx configs ([see changes announcement](https://info.linuxserver.io/issues/2022-08-20-nginx-base)).
Create separate volume for image data
Add ffmpeg and other deps as needed by popular plugins.
Switching to new Base images, shift to arm32v7 tag.
Rebase to alpine linux 3.8 , add pipeline logic and multi arch.
Use repo pinning to better solve dependencies, use repo version of php7-imagick.
Rebase to alpine linux 3.5 and nginx.

image.title: Piwigo
image.setup_instructions:
* You must create a user and database for piwigo to use in a mysql/mariadb server.

* Self-signed keys are generated the first time you run the container and can be found in `/config/keys`, if needed, you can replace them with your own.

* The easiest way to edit the configuration file is to enable local files editor from the plugins page and use it to configure email settings etc."

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  piwigo:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/piwigo:latest
    container_name: piwigo
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/piwigo/config:/config
      - /path/to/appdata/gallery:/gallery
    ports:
      - 80:80
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=piwigo \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 80:80 \
  -v /path/to/piwigo/config:/config \
  -v /path/to/appdata/gallery:/gallery \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/piwigo:latest
